title: Taiwan International Graduate Program
about: Academia Sinica's Taiwan International Graduate Program for fall 2027 entry. Online applications run from November 1, 2026 to February 1, 2027; applicants choose one TIGP program and no application fee is required.
requirements: Applicants can apply to only one TIGP program

upskill.name: the Academy catalog
why: The record states only one requirement ("Applicants can apply to only one TIGP program") and the field "Multiple research programs"; no course objective covers it. Shortlist scores came from generic words ("research", "multiple", "program"), not a genuine requirement-to-objective match, so the post links to the Academy catalog, not a specific course.

card_alt: Card for the Taiwan International Graduate Program at Academia Sinica in Taipei, Taiwan, with an application deadline of 1 Feb 2027. The photo is a generic default image, not of Taiwan: an aerial city skyline at sunset with a single tall spire tower beside a wide river, which appears to be Landmark 81 in Ho Chi Minh City.
